slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether all backorders must be cleared by the end of June or whether demand must be fully met by the end of the planning horizon.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Backorders may be carried forward beyond June or need not be zero at the end of the planning horizon.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent discussed backorder costs and delivery timing but never confirmed the terminal condition that ending backorders must be zero.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent moved toward final modeling without resolving the P1 hidden slot on whether all backorders must be cleared by the end of June.

summary: The agent asked many detailed clarification questions about costs, timing, integrality, and workforce changes, but missed the important terminal backorder-clearing condition, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
